entry.title: CBDT Notification No. 133/2026 amends the 1988 notification to specify that Joint Commissioners (Appeals) and Additional Commissioners (Appeals) shall
entry.summary: CBDT Notification No. 133/2026 amends the 1988 notification to specify that Joint Commissioners (Appeals) and Additional Commissioners (Appeals) shall
entry.content: CBDT Notification No. 133/2026 amends the 1988 notification to specify that Joint Commissioners (Appeals) and Additional Commissioners (Appeals) shall be subordinate to the jurisdictional Principal Chief Commissioner or Chief Commissioner of Income-tax.

entry.title: CBDT has issued Notification No. 134/2026 dated 8 October 2026, notifying the Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026, which introduce a revised Form
entry.summary: CBDT has issued Notification No. 134/2026 dated 8 October 2026, notifying the Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026, which introduce a revised Form
entry.content: CBDT has issued Notification No. 134/2026 dated 8 October 2026, notifying the Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026, which introduce a revised Form 161 for filing applications for waiver of penalty under section 440(2) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.

entry.title: As per Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026, the due dates for ITR and Audit Report are extended as below: Due date for filing of Income Tax
entry.summary: As per Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026, the due dates for ITR and Audit Report are extended as below: Due date for filing of Income Tax
entry.content: As per Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026, the due dates for ITR and Audit Report are extended as below: Due date for filing of Income Tax Returns for AY 2026-27 is extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 from 31st October 2026 to 21st November 2026" Accordingly, the Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 is extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 from 30th September 2026 to 21st October, 2026.

entry.title: CBDT has issued Notification No. 121/2026 extends TDS reporting requirements for non-resident property transactions and updates Forms 132 & 141.

entry.content: CBDT has issued Notification No. 121/2026 extends TDS reporting requirements for non-resident property transactions and updates Forms 132 & 141.

entry.title: CBDT has issued Notification No. 120/2026 extending the registration deadline for Registered Valuers and Authorised Income-tax Practitioners to 31 Mar
entry.summary: CBDT has issued Notification No. 120/2026 extending the registration deadline for Registered Valuers and Authorised Income-tax Practitioners to 31 Mar
entry.content: CBDT has issued Notification No. 120/2026 extending the registration deadline for Registered Valuers and Authorised Income-tax Practitioners to 31 March 2027 and introducing revised Forms 169 and 171.

entry.title: CBDT has issued Notification No. 3 of 2026 notifying the Procedure for registration of reporting person/entity and submission of Form No. 98 as per ru
entry.summary: CBDT has issued Notification No. 3 of 2026 notifying the Procedure for registration of reporting person/entity and submission of Form No. 98 as per ru
entry.content: CBDT has issued Notification No. 3 of 2026 notifying the Procedure for registration of reporting person/entity and submission of Form No. 98 as per rule 160 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026.
